title: Using CSS to Target Membership plans | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Using CSS to Target Membership plans Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000102977 Previously to edit the look of member search results for a particular membership plan required complicated PHP in specific areas of code was required. Now we've made it easier to control by including a class to the <body> element that will be used: <div class="level_#"> (the # is to be replaced with the membership ID) In the example below Company A is in membership plan ID 6 With this class it will be easier to hide or change simple elements like menu items, buttons, links, images using CSS in the Design Settings rather than having to go into specific sections of the code and use PHP every time. Example Using the CSS Method Target the element or area that will be modified. In this example, the Background Color of the members in the membership plan 6: After applying the CSS, only the members from membership plan 6 will show with a different background color: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
